_comment: Art pass 2, 2026-10-02, batch S: Sabotage's charge, sites and first-person frames. Plan: docs/plans/art-pass-2-20261002.md.
The charge belongs to the free side (bone, leather, ember); the site plates are Union issue
(black steel, restrained red). The charge is drawn in the first pass's pickup style and is then
the reference for the planted charge and the first-person frames, which reuse the first pass's
glove and camera. Letters A and B and the timer lamp states are composited locally by
tools/bake_sabotage_art.gd, because generated letters are unreliable and states must register.
Each upload:<file> stood for a temporary provider URL of that local keeper, recorded in
art/raw/art-pass-2-20261002/references.jsonl. To rerun, upload the keeper with fragr-spritegen upload and substitute its public URL.
style: retro pixel art item pickup sprite for a 1990s PC shooter in the same chunky pixel style as the reference picture, crisp stepped pixel clusters, dark outline, limited palette of worn warm brown leather, bone white, ember orange, brass, gunmetal grey and deep shadow with clear value contrast, broad flat areas of colour with hard-edged cel shading, flat even lighting, no gradients, no grain
view: three-quarter view from slightly above, resting on the floor, centred, the whole object visible with even margins
technical: the whole background is one flat solid pure magenta #FF00FF colour with no checkerboard, no pattern, no gradient and no shadow on it, no text, no letters, no numbers, no watermark, no border
